rows.priorFinding: The physical room and Vimalakirti comparison are well bounded, but 'documentary narrator of the Niutou lineage case' is stored in MasterName. Xu Fu and other non-master/imperial actors also require ActorAttribution rather than master links.
rows.finding: REVISE — The old documentary label was demoted, but O1, O3, O5, O7, and O8 are tomb/location or biographical narration assigned to the person described (and O8 even assigns Huineng to Yulin’s imperial scene).

rows.priorFinding: The architectural gate and threshold deployment are strong, but two documentary-narrator labels are MasterName values. The monastic-code row and narrated gate case must use reviewed narration, not invented masters.
rows.finding: REVISE — The two explicit narrator strings were demoted, but O5 is monastic-rule prose assigned to Baizhang and O6 is tomb-location narration assigned to Lingao; neither person utters 山門 there.

rows.finding: REVISE — The sense remains sound, but quoted Buddha speech and ceremony/biographical frames are still flattened into the enclosing named master; exact utterer versus quoter has not been documented.

rows.finding: REVISE — Compiler labels were demoted, but the remaining inherited/formula turns still rely on record-owner assignment rather than a demonstrated exact speaker in the full case.

rows.priorFinding: The canon-librarian office is concrete, but two documentary-narrator labels occupy MasterName and appointment/roster rows are not utterances. Separate office-holder speech from compiler naming and institutional catalogue evidence.
rows.finding: REVISE — Appointment, roster, and office-history narration continues to use the office-holder or record subject as MasterName; naming a 藏主 is not that person uttering 藏主.

rows.priorFinding: The calendrical event is well distinguished from reenactment, but three documentary-narrator strings are MasterName. Date headings and assembly labels have no master utterer unless the exact headword lies inside a preserved speech turn.

rows.finding: REVISE — The non-roster Songshan label was demoted, but questioner and later-quoter ownership around the numbered Linji phrase remains unresolved.

rows.finding: REVISE — Ceremony, questioner, and documentary roles were demoted inconsistently; surviving Dragon-King rows still need exact separation of invoker, quoted figure, and narrator.

rows.finding: REVISE — The final-move gloss is sound, but later citations and embedded cases still inherit the container master as utterer without exact-clause proof.
